rules.title: Santa Ana Rent Stabilization Ordinance
rules.requirement: Annual rent increases are capped at the lower of 3% or 80% of the 12-month CPI change; if CPI is negative, no increase is allowed. Owners must give written notice of the ordinance and tenant rights at lease start or with any rent increase notice.
rules.quoted_span: Increase in residential rents are limited to the lower of 3% per year, or 80% of the percent change in the Consumer Price Index over the most recent 12-month period.
rules.effective_date_note: Document says the ordinances are not effective until November 19, 2021; the city publishes the allowable increase by June 30 each year, effective September 1.
rules.key_value: Lower of 3% or 80% of CPI; no increase if CPI negative
rules.coverage_conditions: Residential buildings constructed on or before Feb 1, 1995; mobile home spaces offered for rent on or before Jan 1, 1990.
rules.exemptions: Buildings constructed after Feb 1, 1995; mobile home spaces offered for rent after Jan 1, 1990. Owners may petition for relief for a fair and reasonable return.
rules.interaction: Local cap applies instead of the state cap where both cover a unit.
rules.conflict_note: The document gives no ordinance number or code section, so the citation is descriptive. The page is a 2021 announcement; a September 2026 newsletter on the page suggests the ordinance is still in operation.

unverifiable_exemptions: owner petition for fair return relief

rules.title: Santa Ana Just Cause Eviction Ordinance
rules.requirement: After 30 days of tenancy, an owner may not end a tenancy without a just cause stated in a written notice. The owner must first give notice of a curable violation. For no-fault terminations the owner must give 3 months of relocation assistance or waive the last 3 months of rent.
rules.citation: Santa Ana Just Cause Eviction Ordinance (adopted 2021)
rules.quoted_span: After 30 days, an owner shall not terminate a tenancy without just cause, which shall be stated in a written notice.
rules.effective_date_note: Document says the ordinances are not effective until November 19, 2021; owners had to notify existing tenants before December 19, 2021.
rules.key_value: Just cause required after 30 days; 3 months relocation assistance for no-fault
rules.exemptions: Housing produced in the last 15 years; deed-restricted affordable housing; hotel and transient occupancy; hospital and care facilities; dormitories; other shared living quarters.
rules.interaction: Local ordinance governs instead of the state just-cause law where both apply.
rules.conflict_note: The document gives no ordinance number or code section, so the citation is descriptive.

parsed.doc_summary: 2021 City of Santa Ana announcement of its Rent Stabilization Ordinance (cap of the lower of 3% or 80% of CPI, buildings built before Feb 1, 1995 covered) and Just Cause Eviction Ordinance (3 months relocation for no-fault), both effective 2021-11-19.
